name: funcheap
description: Funcheap SF (sf.funcheap.com): hand-picked free and cheap San Francisco Bay Area events. This CLI lists events by date, today or weekend, category, region or neighborhood, venue and recurring series, and fetches event details. Each result has title, date/time, cost, venue and URL.

commands.name: list-events-by-date
commands.summary: List events happening on a specific calendar date (WordPress date archive). The details field holds date, time, cost and venue text.
commands.sample: {"title":"Oakland Halloween + Día de los Muertos: Tricks, Treats & Traditions in the Laurel (2026)","url":"https://sf.funcheap.com/oakland-halloween-da-de-los-muertos-tricks-treats-traditions-laurel-2026/","details":"Oakland Halloween + Día de los Muertos: Tricks, Treats & Traditions in the Laurel (2026) Saturday, October 24 – 12:00 pm - Ends at 3:00 pm | Co

commands.name: list-events-by-region
commands.summary: List upcoming events in a region or neighborhood, e.g. san-francisco, east-bay, peninsula, south-bay, north-bay, soma-san-francisco. Paginated.

params.name: region
params.description: Region or neighborhood slug as in /region/{slug}/, e.g. soma-san-francisco, mission-san-francisco, san-francisco, east-bay, peninsula, south-bay, north-bay

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number (10 events per page)

commands.sample: {"title":"“Sqream” Oasis’ Wild + Immersive ’90s Drag Horror Musical (Halloween 2026)","url":"https://sf.funcheap.com/sqream-oasis-wild-immersive-90s-drag-horror-musical-halloween-2026/","details":"“Sqream” Oasis’ Wild + Immersive ’90s Drag Horror Musical (Halloween 2026) Saturday, October 31 – 6:30 pm - Ends at 9:00 pm | Cost: $50 | Oasis

commands.name: list-events-by-category
commands.summary: List upcoming events in an event-type category such as live music, comedy, eating & drinking, art & museums or movies. Paginated.

params.name: category
params.description: Event-type category slug, e.g. live-music-event, comedy-event-types-event, eating-drinking, art-museums, movies

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number (10 events per page)

commands.sample: {"title":"SF’s 44th Annual Sandcastle Classic Contest at Ocean Beach (2026)","url":"https://sf.funcheap.com/leap-arts-annual-sandcastle-classic/","details":"SF’s 44th Annual Sandcastle Classic Contest at Ocean Beach (2026) Saturday, October 24 – 11:00 am - Ends at 3:30 pm | Cost: FREE | Ocean Beach

commands.name: list-weekend-events
commands.summary: List events for this weekend. Pass --next 1 for the following weekend.

params.name: next
params.description: Set to 1 to get next weekend instead of this weekend

commands.name: list-calendar-events
commands.summary: Day-by-day calendar of upcoming events for a calendar region (san-francisco, east-bay). Rows without a url are date headings. Paginated.

commands.name: get-event
commands.summary: Get an event's detail page metadata (name, description, URL, image) by its slug, the path segment of an event url.

params.name: slug
params.description: Event slug from a listing url, e.g. https://sf.funcheap.com/{slug}/

commands.name: list-new-events
commands.summary: RSS feed of recently added events, site-wide only (per-region feeds redirect here), with title, link, publish date and categories.
